verdict.rationale: Cal.com lets you register event-type webhooks with selectable triggers (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_PAID, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, and others) that send a templated payload to a subscriber URL, so actions fire automatically on events. Native 'workflows' appear only as a one-line mention in llms.txt, with no documentation of how rules, conditions or actions are defined. Missing for 10: documented first-party workflow rule builder (conditions, action types such as email/SMS/reminders), evidence of rule logic beyond webhook trigger selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
